office_does: The coroner investigates unexpected, unattended or suspicious deaths, decides on autopsies and toxicology, notifies families and signs death certificates.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Tanner Bateman (Prefers Republican Party), coroner since 2023 and a former deputy coroner, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Douglas County Coroner since 2023, an Army veteran and certified death investigator; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Coroner since 2023 after serving as deputy coroner [S1]
Says in-house transport of autopsy cases saves the county money [S1]
Set up tissue and organ donation with SightLife and LifeNet Health [S1]
